_comment: Starting master records, from BRD V1.0 and KRL's paper formats. Each list is loaded only when its master is empty, so after that KRL owns it and nothing is brought back.

HSE Severity Level.action_required: Bear the risk as it is, with continuous monitoring (opportunity for improvement)
HSE Severity Level.rectification_condition: If more time is needed it must be informed with genuine reasons

HSE Severity Level.action_required: Control risk: bear the risk with control measures in place
HSE Severity Level.rectification_condition: If more time is needed it must be informed with genuine reasons

HSE Severity Level.definition: Violation which may cause injury: rules, procedure or PPE
HSE Severity Level.action_required: Reduce risk: undesirable, reduce to low or very low
HSE Severity Level.rectification_condition: If more time is needed it must be informed with genuine reasons; CAPA is mandatory

HSE Severity Level.definition: Unsafe act or conditions, serious injury potential, stop work
HSE Severity Level.action_required: Stop the activity, reduce risk to low or very low, then restart the activity
HSE Severity Level.rectification_condition: Work is stopped until rectification is done; CAPA is mandatory

HSE Severity Level.definition: DANGER: immediate injury potential, stop work
HSE Severity Level.action_required: Stop all work, reduce risk to low or very low, then restart all work
HSE Severity Level.rectification_condition: Work is stopped until rectification is done; CAPA is mandatory
